actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Publish a message to Twitch chat on the broadcaster channel.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Plain text. Twitch chat enforces a 500-character limit.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution from the trigger event (e.g. {user.name}).

actions.name: Shoutout
actions.description: Send a Twitch shoutout for another channel, the same one the /shoutout chat command sends.

schema.label: Channel
schema.description: The channel to shout out. A numeric user id is used as-is; anything else is resolved as a login name.
schema.hint: Supports template substitution, so a raid trigger can pass its raider straight through.
